title_jp: もしこれが{映画|えいが}だったら
context: Sunday 3 January, the snowshoe date at {戸隠|とがくし}: after walking to the snow-covered {鏡池|かがみいけ}, アルちゃん and レン warm up in a soba shop where the TV shows the second day of the {箱根駅伝|はこねえきでん}.
scene: After a morning on snowshoes, you and レン thaw out over {戸隠|とがくし} soba. The TV is showing the {箱根駅伝|はこねえきでん}.

phrases.jp: もし{時間|じかん}を{戻せたら|もどせたら|to turn back, return (something)|3}、あの{日|ひ}に{戻りたい|もどりたい}な。
phrases.en: If I could turn back time, I'd go back to that day.

phrases.jp: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は、よく{雪|ゆき}で{遊んだ|あそんだ}ものだ。
phrases.en: When I was a kid, I used to play in the snow a lot.
phrases.note: た-form + ものだ: fond memories of a past habit.

phrases.jp: {生まれ変わったら|うまれかわったら|to be reborn|3}、{何|なに}になりたい？
phrases.en: If you were born again, what would you want to be?

phrases.jp: お{正月|しょうがつ}は、{家族|かぞく}で{過ごす|すごす}ものです。
phrases.en: New Year is something you spend with your family.
phrases.note: Dictionary form + ものだ: 'that's how it's done'.

phrases.jp: {雪|ゆき}が{降らなければ|ふらなければ}、{山|やま}が{見えた|みえた}のになあ。
phrases.en: If it weren't snowing, we'd have seen the mountain.
phrases.note: 〜のに at the end = a small regret.

dialogue_setting: A soba shop in {戸隠|とがくし}, Sunday lunchtime. Wet snowshoes by the door, steam from the bowls, the relay race on TV.

dialogue.speaker: レン
dialogue.jp: この{時期|じき}の{鏡池|かがみいけ}、{真っ白|まっしろ}だったね。{夏|なつ}なら{山|やま}が{池|いけ}に{映る|うつる|to be reflected|3}んだよ。
dialogue.en: {鏡池|かがみいけ} was all white at this time of year. In summer the mountain is reflected in the pond.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: {映画|えいが}のワンシーンみたいだった。もしこれが{映画|えいが}だったら、{次|つぎ}はどうなる？
dialogue.en: It was like a scene from a film. If this were a film, what would happen next?

dialogue.speaker: レン
dialogue.jp: {二人|ふたり}で{遭難|そうなん|getting lost in the mountains|2}して…って、{冗談|じょうだん|joke|4}だよ。{温かい|あたたかい|warm (food)|4}そばでハッピーエンドかな。
dialogue.en: We both get lost in the mountains… just kidding. A happy ending with hot soba, I think.

dialogue.speaker: レン
dialogue.jp: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は、{正月|しょうがつ}になると{父|ちち}と{駅伝|えきでん|long-distance relay race|3}の{中継|ちゅうけい|live broadcast|3}を{見た|みた}ものだよ。
dialogue.en: When I was a kid, every New Year I used to watch the relay race on TV with my dad.

dialogue.speaker: アルちゃん
dialogue.jp: スペインでは、{大晦日|おおみそか}にテレビの{鐘|かね|bell|3}に{合わせて|あわせて|to keep time with|3}、ぶどうを12{粒|つぶ|grain, (counter for) small round things|3}{食べる|たべる}ものなんだ。
dialogue.en: In Spain, on New Year's Eve you eat twelve grapes in time with the bells on TV.

dialogue.speaker: レン
dialogue.jp: {面白い|おもしろい}！…ねえ、もし{僕|ぼく}の{友達|ともだち}に{会って|あって}くれたら、{嬉しい|うれしい}な。みんな{会いたがってる|あいたがってる}んだ。
dialogue.en: That's fun! …Hey, if you'd meet my friends, I'd be happy. They all want to meet you.

listening.intro: Paying at the counter, レン checks the time.

lines.jp: {帰り|かえり}のバス、2{時|じ}{半|はん}だって。{急ごう|いそごう}。
lines.en: The bus back is at half past two. Let's hurry.

grammar.meaning: used to / that's just how it is
grammar.form: used to: verb た-form + ものだ ({見|み}たものだ, {遊|あそ}んだものだ) · that's how it is: dictionary form + ものだ ({食|た}べるものだ, {過|す}ごすものだ) · casual: もんだ ({行|い}ったもんだ)
grammar.explanation: With the た-form it looks back fondly at a past habit: 'I used to…'. With the dictionary form it states what's natural or customary: 'that's what you do'. Not for one single event: 'I went yesterday' is just {行|い}った.

examples.jp: {昔|むかし}はこの{坂|さか|slope|3}を、{毎日|まいにち}{歩いた|あるいた}ものだ。
examples.en: In the old days I used to walk up this slope every day.

examples.jp: {冬|ふゆ}になると、{温かい|あたたかい}ものが{食べ|たべ}たくなるものだ。
examples.en: When winter comes, you just want something warm to eat.

quiz.question: {若い|わかい}{頃|ころ}は、よく{夜中|よなか}まで{映画|えいが}を＿＿。
quiz.en: When I was young, I often used to watch films until late at night.
quiz.explain: A past habit: た-form + ものだ.

quiz_more.question: お{正月|しょうがつ}は、{家族|かぞく}で{過ごす|すごす}＿＿。
quiz_more.en: New Year is something you spend with family.
quiz_more.explain: Dictionary form + ものだ: 'that's how it's done'.

quiz_more.question: {昨日|きのう}、{初めて|はじめて}{戸隠|とがくし}へ＿＿。
quiz_more.en: Yesterday I went to {戸隠|とがくし} for the first time.
quiz_more.explain: One single event, not a habit: no ものだ.

kanji.where: In the corner of the soba shop's TV screen: 「{箱根駅伝|はこねえきでん} {復路|ふくろ}」.
kanji.breakdown: {復路|ふくろ}: 復 go back, return + 路 road → 'the road back': day 2, from {箱根|はこね} back to Tokyo.
kanji.related: {往路|おうろ} = the outward leg (day 1, 2 January).

tip.title: {箱根駅伝|はこねえきでん}
tip.body: On 2 and 3 January, university teams run a relay of over 200 km from Tokyo to {箱根|はこね} and back, ten runners per team. Many families leave it on TV all morning, like a New Year ritual. Ask someone which university they support and you'll get a long answer.

challenge.prompt: レン: 「アルちゃんは、{子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}、{冬|ふゆ}に{何|なに}してた？」 You answered, but one part is wrong.

parts.why: Dictionary form + ものだ means 'that's what one does'. For 'I used to', use the た-form: {登|のぼ}ったものだ.

challenge.model_answer: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}は、{冬|ふゆ}になると{祖父|そふ}と{山|やま}に{登った|のぼった}ものだよ。
challenge.explanation: 〜になると = 'whenever (winter) came'. {登|のぼ}った + ものだ looks back fondly at a habit: 'I used to climb'. よ keeps it warm and casual for レン.
challenge.hint: A past habit: た-form + ものだ

vocab.en: to be reflected; to appear (on screen)
vocab.note: {池|いけ}に{映|うつ}る, テレビに{映|うつ}る. Transitive: {映|うつ}す.
{冗談|じょうだん}だよ = just kidding. {冗談|じょうだん}でしょう？ = you're kidding?
News word for climbers in trouble. {遭難|そうなん}する.
Things you touch or eat. Weather is {暖|あたた}かい.
{生中継|なまちゅうけい} = live on air.
{除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね} = the 108 bells on New Year's Eve.

vocab.en: grain; counter for small round things
vocab.note: ぶどう12{粒|つぶ}, {米|こめ}{一粒|ひとつぶ}.
Transitive pair of {戻|もど}る. {元|もと}に{戻|もど}す = put back as it was.
{生|う}まれる be born + {変|か}わる change. Also 'become a new person'.

kanji_study.kun: うつ(る)・うつ(す)・は(える)
kanji_study.parts: 日 sun + 央 centre → the sun right in the middle, its light bouncing back from water and glass: reflect, project.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 英 (English, excellent): 英 has 艹 grass on top instead of 日 on the left.

kanji_study.parts: 其 a basket (gives the sound キ) + 月 moon → the moon marks out fixed stretches of time: period, term.
kanji_study.lookalike: Not 基 (base): 基 has 土 earth at the bottom; 期 has 月 on the right.

extras.title: Talking about films
extras.intro: For the next time レン brings up old movies.

items.note: ネタバレしないで！ = no spoilers!

items.jp: もし{時間|じかん}があったら…
{雪|ゆき}が{降らなければ|ふらなければ}…
items.note: ば: a bit more written or regretful.
